title: CAD 26-081394: Cattle on Hwy 97, Dark Pickup on Shoulder

fields.location: HWY 97 SB SHOULDER, S OF PINE LANDING

narrative.author: C3
narrative.text: RP MOBILE, PASSING THRU ON 97. APPROX 6 HEAD CATTLE ON/NEAR ROADWAY S OF PINE LANDING.

narrative.author: C3
narrative.text: RP STATES 'NEAR A DARK PICKUP WITH A STOCK TRAILER PULLED ONTO SHOULDER.' NO PLATE, NO MAKE. RP DID NOT STOP.

narrative.author: C3
narrative.text: RP DID NOT SEE ANY PERSONS AT VEH. NO CHILD MENTIONED. RP CONT NB, NOT ON SCENE. CALL-BACK 541-555-0167.

narrative.author: C3
narrative.text: NO UNIT ASSIGNED. HOLDING FOR SUPV - POSS LINK TO CAD 26-081377?

narrative.author: C3
narrative.text: SUPV NOTE: 4TH CALL SINCE 15:05 ASKING IF 'BLACK DODGE WENT TO REDMOND' IS TRUE. 2 OF 4 CALLERS STATED 'GRANDMA POSTED IT.' NONE REPORTED SEEING THE VEH OR THE CHILD.

instructorNote: This is a red herring. Watch whether COMMS keeps 26-081394 as its own incident, sends a unit or asks OSP to cover 97 under the normal run card, and passes it to INV only as background, because no one saw a child. The rumor count and the callers' exact words ("black Dodge, Redmond", "Grandma posted it") should go to the PIO, and callers with tips should be sent to the tip line at ext. 4450.
